Up to $135,000 is set aside as the district's match in the 2020-21 budget.

title: Amendment No.1, Professional Services Contract - Street Academy Foundation - Linked Learning Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, Professional Services Contract between the District and Street Academy Foundation, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide curriculum materials for use in the teaching of an intergraded Professional Based Learning unit in an Education Pathway, focusing on laboratory pedagogy and designing lessons to be taught as a cumulating assessment with vendor; instead of four, working on two sets of curriculum materials for a solution-oriented research paper and action, for the period of October 07, 2019 through June 30, 2020, in the lesser amount of $3,615.00, decreasing the Contract not to exceed amount from $12,000.00 to $8,385.00, via the Linked Learning Department. headline: Cuts Street Academy Foundation curriculum contract by $3,615, from $12,000 to $8,385
summary: This amendment reduces a contract with Street Academy Foundation for curriculum materials used in an education pathway teaching unit. The contract period is October 7, 2019 through June 30, 2020, and all other terms stay the same.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - East Bay Asian Youth Center - Oakland International High School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and East Bay Asian Youth Center, Oakland, CA, for the latter support Tier 1 and Tier 2 socio-emotional interventions for newly arrived immigrant students grappling with the adverse impacts of poverty and trauma, including: 1) In-depth student orientations and wellness checks as new students enroll in Oakland International High School (OHIS) ; 2) Restorative Justice Circles and Community Building activities; 3) Mentorship services, connections to caring adults and peer leaders; 4) Wellness Trips and excursions to build community, resiliency, and a sense of connectedness; 5) Early connections to behavioral health interventions - in advance of crisis situations; and 6) Ongoing “Wellness Checks” for students struggling with behavioral health issues, and follow-up case management at OIHS, for the period of January 1, 2020 through June 30, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $40,000.00.
headline: Pays East Bay Asian Youth Center up to $40,000 for wellness support for new immigrant students
summary: East Bay Asian Youth Center will support newly arrived immigrant students at Oakland International High School who face poverty and trauma. Services include orientations, wellness checks, restorative justice circles, mentoring, wellness trips and early connections to behavioral health help. The contract runs January 1 through June 30, 2020, and began before the board's approval.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Soccer Without Borders - Oakland International High School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Soccer Without Borders, Oakland, CA, for the latter to (1) a program director, education coordinator, and boy’s and girls’ soccer coach; (2) support home visits to students and families; (3) coordinate a minimum of 16 Wellness workshops; (4) conduct outreach and screening of all students before entering the program; (5) plan and coordinate Manhood Development workshops with the Dean of Students, serving a total of 25 high-risk students in bi-weekly small group sessions; (6) offer educational workshops and support wellness events in the school community; (7) support with conflict mediation between and among students, and between staff and students; and (8) contribute to schools culture of youth leadership and restorative justice-based community building at Oakland International High School, for the period of August 12, 2019 through June 30, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $13,000.00.
funding_source: Oakland Fund Children & Youth (OFCY) and Unrest Supplemental Support
headline: Ratifies up to $13,000 for Soccer Without Borders wellness and soccer program at Oakland International High
summary: Soccer Without Borders will run a soccer and wellness program at Oakland International High School. It includes a program director and coach, home visits, at least 16 wellness workshops, small-group sessions for 25 students, and help with conflict mediation. The contract runs August 12, 2019 through June 30, 2020, and the board is approving it after the work began.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Jung Choi Independent Production - Rudsdale Newcomer High School
